flow-definition.description: On-demand + weekly garbage collection for the registry:2 store. CNCF registry has NO automatic GC — overwritten/old image blobs accumulate forever (every businessplanner/metabuilder rebuild orphans layers). Without this the ~19 GB dedupe win erodes within a few rebuild cycles. --delete-untagged also drops untagged manifests. Run in a low-traffic window (no concurrent pushes); registry is restarted after to clear state. Pairs with docker-dedupe.
